title: Hardware Watchdog Timers
description: Uses the SoC's hardware watchdog to reset the system when software stops petting it. The timer runs independently of the CPU; expiry pulls reset. It is the last line of defense against total hangs.

demo.title: Demo — Hardware Watchdog Timers

title: Windowed Watchdogs
description: Requires pets inside a time window — not too early, not too late. Early pets suggest a runaway loop petting blindly; late pets mean a hang. The window catches both failure modes.

demo.title: Demo — Windowed Watchdogs

title: Heartbeat Protocols
description: Exchanges periodic heartbeats between supervisor and workers to detect stalls. Missing heartbeats trigger restart of the silent component; sequence numbers catch replays. It distributes the watchdog idea across processes.

demo.title: Demo — Heartbeat Protocols

title: Multi-Stage Escalation
description: Escalates from logging to service restart to full reboot as lower stages fail. Each stage gets a chance to fix the problem before the next, harsher one fires. It avoids rebooting for recoverable glitches.

demo.title: Demo — Multi-Stage Escalation

title: PMIC Watchdogs
description: Uses the power-management IC's watchdog to handle hangs during early boot and suspend. The PMIC watches before the SoC watchdog is even configured. It covers the window other watchdogs miss.
key_mechanisms: Hand off to the SoC watchdog

demo.title: Demo — PMIC Watchdogs

title: Software Watchdog Threads
description: Runs a high-priority watchdog thread that checks worker progress and restarts stuck work. It cannot survive a kernel hang, but it catches application deadlocks cheaply. Every long-running service should have one.

demo.title: Demo — Software Watchdog Threads

title: Watchdog Daemons
description: Deploys system watchdog daemons that pet the hardware timer and monitor load. The daemon also watches temperature, memory, and load average, rebooting on serious trouble. It bridges software policy and hardware reset.

demo.title: Demo — Watchdog Daemons

title: Pet Strategy Design
description: Designs pet strategies so only genuinely-healthy code pets the watchdog. Petting from the main loop proves the loop runs; petting from an ISR proves nothing. The pet location is the design.
key_mechanisms: Pet from the supervised code path

demo.title: Demo — Pet Strategy Design

title: Timeout Tuning
description: Tunes watchdog timeouts from measured worst-case execution times plus margin. Too short causes spurious resets; too long delays recovery. Profiling under load sets the number.

demo.title: Demo — Timeout Tuning

title: Watchdog During Suspend
description: Keeps watchdog coverage across suspend and resume, the window where hangs hide. The PMIC or always-on domain watches while the SoC sleeps; resume re-arms the main timer. It closes the sleep blind spot.

demo.title: Demo — Watchdog During Suspend

title: Cascaded Watchdogs
description: Cascades watchdogs so each level watches the one below: task, supervisor, hardware. A stuck task trips the supervisor; a stuck supervisor trips the hardware. No single failure escapes all levels.
key_mechanisms: Each level watches the one below

demo.title: Demo — Cascaded Watchdogs

title: Watchdog Test Injection
description: Tests watchdogs by deliberately hanging the system in a safe environment. If the watchdog does not fire, the test fails; untested watchdogs are decorations. Fault injection proves the recovery path.

demo.title: Demo — Watchdog Test Injection

title: Boot-Loop Protection
description: Detects boot loops with a counter in non-volatile storage and falls back after N failures. Repeated watchdog resets during boot increment the counter; at the limit the system boots a recovery image. It stops infinite reset cycles.
key_mechanisms: Reset the counter on good boot

demo.title: Demo — Boot-Loop Protection

title: Remote Watchdog via BMC
description: Lets the baseboard management controller watchdog the host independently. The BMC pings the host and power-cycles on silence; it works even when the host is fully hung. Datacenter standard.

demo.title: Demo — Remote Watchdog via BMC

title: Watchdog Event Logging
description: Logs watchdog events with context to non-volatile storage for post-mortem. Which timer fired, what the system was doing, and the escalation taken — all recorded. Without logs, watchdog resets are mysteries.

demo.title: Demo — Watchdog Event Logging
